title: Asghar ko leke goud me
body:
Lyrics
Hai Asgar ..........(6)
Asgar Ko Like Godh Mein Kehti Hai Karbala .....
<<MINI>>
Yeh Woh Ali (a.s) Hai Jisko Kabhi Ghar Nahi Mila .....(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
Cheh Mah Ke Garib, Musafir Ko Soup Ke.....
Kehhne Lage Hussain (As) Yeh, Kabre Sagreer Se ....
Rakhna Zara Khayal Mera Tashnakaam Ka.....
<<MINI>>
Yeh Who Ali (a.s) Hai Jisko Kabhi Ghar Nahi Mila .....(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Madar Yeh Bain Karti Thi Dil Me Hai Yeh Kasak.....
Sugra Tumhari Godh Se Aagosh E Kabr Tak.....
Asgar Ko Maut Ne Kahin Rukne Nahi Diya....
<<MINI>>
Yeh Who Ali (a.s) Hai Jisko Kabhi Ghar Nahi Mila .....(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Maa Soch Ti Thi Dhalta Hai Din Ho Rahi Hai Sham.....
Jhule Me Laut Aaienga Shayad Who Tashnakaam..... Lekin Gazab Hua ke Woh Jhula Bhi Jal Gaya.....
<<MINI>>
Yeh Who Ali (a.s) Hai Jisko Kabhi Ghar Nahi Mila .....(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Galion Me Shehr E Kufa Ke Bazaar E Sham Me.....
Shiri Ke Ghar Kabhi, Kabhi Darbar e Sham Me....
Marne Ke Baad Bhi Abhi Asgar Safar Me Tha....
<<MINI>>
Yeh Who Ali (a.s) Hai Jisko Kabhi Ghar Nahi Mila .....(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Nanhe Se Sar Ko Yaas Se Bus Takte Rahte The....
Phir Khoon Ro Ke Sayyad E Sajjad (As) Kehte The....
Main Who Ali (a.s) Hun Jiska, Bhara Ghar Ujad Gaya.....
<<MINI>>
Yeh Who Ali (a.s) Hai Jisko Kabhi Ghar Nahi Mila .....(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Aane Laga Watan Jo, Garibon Ka Karwan
Mud Mud Ke Kehti Jaati Thi Ek Khali Godh Ma
Rakhio Sambhal Kar Ise Aai Arze Nainawa
<<MINI>>
Yeh Woh Ali (a.s) Hai Jisko Kabhi Ghar Nahi Mila .....(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Dar Hai Yeh Phir se koi Sina Par Utha Na Le....
Lipta Hua Hai Abbhi wo Seene Se Baap Ke.....
Ro Ro Ke Keh Rahi Hai Takallum Yeh Karbala....
<<MINI>>
Yeh Who Ali (a.s) Hai Jisko Kabhi Ghar Nahi Mila .....(2)
